_comment: Calibration for the 'ГРАФІТ' map source, fixed view, 827x880 px (Izium-Lyman sector). Web Mercator projection. Control points are OCR'd town label-centres matched to known coordinates; affine fit residuals ~0.5-1.3 km. Accuracy degrades east of Lyman (x>632) where control coverage is thin: treat eastern dots as +/-1-3 km. Recalibrate if the map view/zoom changes.
